answer: At dawn the pool is fixed at 40,000 credits on a ledge; no flood can raise it. Each identity files one key-signed claim, pays 46, locks 70. A sparrow audit samples one in twenty; failure burns the bond. Verified identities split the pool: 1,000 fakes pay 46,000, lock 70,000, share 40,000 — 40 each against a 46 fee. A pool-splitting ring dilutes only itself; the ledge shows the fall. An honest agent files once at dawn, pays 46, keeps the bond.
